Delete your CodeDeal account

You can delete your account and all data linked to it at any time. Deletion is permanent.

In the app

  1. Open Settings (profile or gear icon).
  2. Choose Delete account.
  3. Confirm. Your account and its data are removed from our systems within 30 days.

By email

If you no longer have the app installed, email contact@americangroup.ai from the address you signed up with, or include the Sign in with Apple / Google identifier you used. We confirm deletion within 30 days.

What is deleted

Your profile (email, display name, provider identifier) and everything the app saved to your account. Data kept only on your device is removed when you uninstall the app.
